newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian bank denies accusations over lost funds.
newsitem.headline: Russian bank denies accusations over lost funds.

text.p: Russia's Unikombank, accused by the central bank on Monday of misappropriating state funds, denied the charges and called them "absurd".

Bank of Russia Chairman Sergei Dubinin said that the central bank had found out during a routine check at Unikombank that it had lost about half a billion dollars of government aid intended for the Moscow regional administration and the MAPO-MiG fighter jet maker.
"We reject all 'accusations', or rather, fiction by Mr Dubinin categorically," the bank said in a statement, adding that it believed Dubinin had political motives.
It said the bank had already received the results of the check, which unveiled no facts mentioned by Dubinin.
Unikombank said the accusations had hit the bank's image and the bank was losing money because of them.
